_doc: Exact document prints: the legacy Oracle Reports layout printed by each document screen (the RDF its print button ran), how the report parameters are filled from the document header (column name, or a SQL expression over the header row aliased t), the legacy print right (SQL returning 1/0; reference :G_USER_CODE only once, it is bound once) and the first-print flag. Further print buttons of the same screen go into "more": [{"key": "DLVR", "label_a": "...", "label_e": "...", "rdf": "...", "params": {...}, "right": "..."}]. "rdf_module" (ST / AC / AR / VN) names the module folder of the legacy report path where the same RDF name exists in several folders with different content (ACJRNL1, ACJRNL2, AR_STTM_HMC2, G_RECEIVE_ORDER, SUPPLIER_REP, st_customer_INVOICE ...). "not_mapped" (per screen) and "_not_mapped" (screens without a mappable print) record legacy print buttons that are deliberately not reproduced, with the reason; "evidence" says where each mapping comes from. The installation code (:GLOBAL.CUSTOMER_CODE, read by the login form Sysmenu from CUSTOMER_PAR, which is empty) is NULL here, so every installation-specific branch takes its ELSE path. Compiled by app/gen/rdfprint.py, drawn by app/static/rdfprint.js, checked with app/tools/rdftest.py. LANG, company, user, group and system parameters are passed automatically.
